_provenance.method: Single HTTP GET per product page. No JavaScript execution, no authentication, no CAPTCHA handling, no bot-protection circumvention.

robots_txt.notes: Search IS disallowed (Disallow: *search?q=*), so products were discovered via the robots.txt-advertised product sitemap rather than the onsite search. /user-api/*, /cqe/*, *idsOnly=*, *productsOnly=* were NOT requested.

_provenance.critical_scope_caveat: These two records were selected only to characterise the page format. lidl.de is NOT a general grocery shop: its advertised catalog is dominated by wine/sparkling wine, non-food goods and plants. See docs/research/supermarket-data-acquisition-spike.md section 2.
